name: Let's Go Motorhomes
verdict: Motorhome rental firm backed by Jayco; nothing found.
note: Australian motorhome and campervan rental company; its 'letsgo' mark is on the collar of the 2026 Team Jayco AlUla jersey. Its own site says it is 'proudly backed by Jayco', which is why ownership is null: the source says 'backed by', not 'owned by'. No state ownership and no human-rights finding found that passes the METHOD.md test.
